title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for recent episode of low blood sugar.

History of Present Illness
The patient is a known case of type 2 diabetes mellitus who presented today complaining of symptoms following a hypoglycemic episode. He reports feeling shaky and weak earlier today. He continues to manage his type 2 diabetes using an oral hypoglycemic agent, specifically metformin, long-term. He denies any recent changes to his usual routine or medications outside of the blood sugar fluctuation.

Medication List
Metformin

Exam
Vitals are stable. Physical exam is benign. Cardiovascular exam is unremarkable. Neurological exam is intact.

Assessment
The patient has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus and presented today following a hypoglycemic episode.

Plan
Continue current management plan for type 2 diabetes. Advised patient on signs and symptoms of hypoglycemia and when to seek immediate care. Continue taking metformin as prescribed. Follow up as needed.
explanations: Diabetes with hypoglycemia and no coma documented: E11.649.
Long-term oral hypoglycemic use: add Z79.84.

distractors.why: Hypoglycemia is a complication with its own code.
Z79.84 captures long-term oral hypoglycemic use.
